gloss: discipline committee member; public morals officer

definitions.gloss: discipline committee member; public morals committee member
definitions.explanation: A student or official responsible for enforcing rules of conduct, dress codes, and general discipline. Most commonly refers to a student role in Japanese schools where members monitor compliance with school rules.

examples.japanese: {風紀委員|ふうきいいん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれた→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: I was chosen as a discipline committee member.

examples.japanese: {風紀委員|ふうきいいん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{校門|こうもん}→校門：13116_koumon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{服装|ふくそう}→服装：03594_fukusou⟧⟦チェック→チェック：03000_chekku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The discipline committee members are checking uniforms in front of the school gate.

examples.japanese: うち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{風紀委員|ふうきいいん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{厳|きび}しくて→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧、⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧や⟦スカート→スカート：01060_sukaato⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{丈|たけ}→丈：29841_take⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{細|こま}かく→細かい：01245_komakai⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The discipline committee at our school is strict — they even nitpick things like hair color and skirt length.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{風紀|ふうき}→風紀：14673_fuuki⟧ (public morals, discipline) and ⟦{委員|いいん}→委員：01708_iin⟧ (committee member). A fixture of Japanese school culture, particularly in middle and high schools. The role frequently appears in anime, manga, and light novels as an archetypal character type — the strict rule-enforcer.

USAGE:
In schools, {風紀委員|ふうきいいん} typically patrol hallways, check uniforms, and report violations. The role carries social weight: being a {風紀委員|ふうきいいん} signals responsibility and seriousness. Outside schools, the term can refer to anyone tasked with monitoring public morals or workplace conduct.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {風紀委員|ふうきいいん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become a discipline committee member
- {風紀委員|ふうきいいん}{長|ちょう}: discipline committee chairperson
- {風紀委員|ふうきいいん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧: discipline committee activities
- {風紀委員|ふうきいいん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be warned by the discipline committee

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {生活指導|せいかつしどう}: student guidance, life guidance — a teacher's role in guiding student behavior, broader than just rule enforcement
- ⟦{委員会|いいんかい}→委員会：12234_iinkai⟧: committee — the general term for any school or organizational committee
- {学級委員|がっきゅういいん}: class representative — a different student leadership role focused on class affairs rather than discipline
